security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Terminal in a window, powered by xterm.js
bundle.longDescription: majin runs a real login shell on a pseudo terminal and renders it with xterm.js. The desktop build talks to the PTY over local IPC, so nothing is exposed on the network.
